seo.title: Trino client for {devices}
seo.description: Query across Trino catalogs, sign in with a password, a JWT or a client certificate over TLS, read logical and distributed plans, and cancel a query.

header.title: Trino client
header.lead: Query across catalogs, inspect plans and cancel running queries; writes depend on each catalog’s connector.

bands.title: Connect and sign in
text: Enter the coordinator host, port and <ui>Username</ui>. <ui>Catalog</ui> and <ui>Schema</ui> set the starting location, and an IANA <ui>Time Zone</ui> sets the session’s.

Sign in with a password, sent as HTTP Basic for LDAP or password-file authentication, or with a JWT access token sent as a bearer credential. Either goes only over TLS: with SSL Disabled, a connection that holds one is refused before anything is sent. A client certificate and key on the SSL pane add mutual TLS.

SSL starts Disabled, which is plain HTTP; every other mode forces TLS with no plaintext fallback, and port 443 turns on Verify Identity. A redirect from a proxy in front of the coordinator is never followed, and the error names where it pointed. Import from URL… brings in a trino:// URL.

bands.title: Query across catalogs
text: Join across catalogs with fully qualified catalog.schema.table names, and browse catalogs, schemas, tables and materialized views, with row-count estimates from SHOW STATS. bigint and decimal are read as exact text, not floating point; varbinary shows as hex, array, map and row as JSON, and timestamps keep the value the server returned.

Explain offers Logical, Distributed, IO, Validate and Analyze, each as raw text: Validate checks a query without running it, and Analyze runs it and reports actual timings. SET SESSION holds for the rest of the connection, and Query > Cancel Query is the way to stop a query, since the connection’s query timeout does not reach Trino.
Trino reports no primary keys, so <editing>cell edits</editing> match every original column, and identical rows change together with no transaction to undo them. Check for duplicates before editing.

bands.title: Structure
text: The <structure>Structure tab</structure> creates tables and adds, drops, renames and retypes columns, in autocommit. Whether a change runs is up to the catalog’s connector, and a type change is the one fewest connectors accept.

moveData: There is no import. <export>Export</export> a table or a result as {exportFormats}.

faq.question: Why does a valid statement come back as NOT_SUPPORTED?
faq.answer: The connector behind that catalog does not implement the operation, whatever Trino’s grammar allows, and a read-only connector refuses every write. Check the connector’s own documentation.

faq.question: Can I use an encrypted client key?
faq.answer: No. Trino connections have no key passphrase field. Write a decrypted copy with openssl pkey -in encrypted.key -out client.key and choose that file.
